lines.text: Today your sprites will learn to make decisions.
If it is raining, then you take an umbrella. If the light is red, then you stop.
In games, if the player touches lava, then they go back to the start.
The if block asks a question with a yes or no answer, called a condition.
If the answer is yes, the blocks inside run. If it is no, they are skipped.
On the left, the sprite checks only once, at the very start. That is a common bug!
Put the if inside a forever loop, and the sprite keeps checking all the time.
Here is a smart robot. If there is a wall ahead, it turns right. Else, it moves.
It repeats until it touches the star. The same code can solve mazes it has never seen!
Brilliant. Now make some decisions in the Code Lab!
